question: Can nested direction-level selection of KL/noise strength prevent complement-DAS construction memorization and beat no-reg plus pooled step zero on both outer families and a new text family?
outer_folds: train complete v8, test complete v10
train complete v10, test complete v8
inner_selection: Inside each outer training family, fit both A1/A2 panels for one cue direction and select on both panels of the opposite direction, then reverse. Rank configurations by worst inner validation six-term score, mean score, update count, then fixed configuration order.
fit: Rank one from frozen pooled/DIM-like initialization; Adam learning rate .025; checkpoints 0/5/10; existing hard per-environment margin/L15 limits; robust log-sum-exp over environments; fixed variance penalty on normalized six-term loss vectors across training panels.
outer_evaluation: Refit each inner-selected configuration on the complete outer training family and evaluate the untouched outer family once. Refit no_reg under the identical nested budget as comparator. Outer outcomes never select hyperparameters.
sealed_evaluation: Choose one global configuration and update count only from aggregate v8/v10 inner scores, refit on all v8+v10 panel-direction environments, then open capability-qualified v15 once. V12 is historical evidence only and is not read by the runner.

predictions.pred_a_authority_disjointness_closure_fi: All hashes/manifests match; v8/v10/v15 rows are disjoint; manual reader closure <=1e-4; every metric is finite; total counted native+manual evaluations <=5000 and updates <=350.
predictions.pred_b_nested_regularization_beats_both_: On each outer fold, the inner-selected nonzero regularized checkpoint is feasible and strictly beats both nested no_reg and pooled step zero on mean and worst six-term score.
predictions.pred_c_inner_selection_is_direction_stab: The two inner direction folds select the same configuration family (same KL/noise setting, update count may differ) within each outer training family.
predictions.pred_d_global_refit_beats_pooled_on_v15: The globally selected refit is feasible and strictly improves both mean and worst complete-v15 score over pooled step zero.
predictions.pred_e_v15_improvement_is_not_target_sac: The global refit improves vocabulary match+inertness on both v15 panels while satisfying every hard margin/L15 target limit.
predictions.pred_f_generalization_gap_shrinks: The worst outer-family excess over corresponding inner validation is smaller than the analogous nested no-reg excess in both outer folds.

terminal_policy.adaptive_but_not_global_objective: A, B, D, and E pass but C fails because outer training families prefer different regularizers.
terminal_policy.inner_selection_mispredicts_construction: A passes but B fails on either outer fold.
terminal_policy.residual_family_memorization: A-C pass but D or E fails on v15.
